title: Decoding the Black Box: Integrating Moral Imagination with Technical AI Governance
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a theoretical and policy-oriented paper on AI governance.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on a framework for technical and ethical AI governance, discussing issues like algorithmic bias (e.g., racial, socioeconomic), security vulnerabilities, and the need for interdisciplinary oversight in high-stakes domains like defense, finance, healthcare, and education.
